g.text: When is the sun highest? The clock time of solar noon in 34,212 cities (4.1 billion people),

text.style: font-size: 13.5px; font-family: 'Inter'; fill: #4a4741

g.text: averaged over 2026. 38% of people see it at 12:30 or later. Only 1% see it at 11:30 or earlier.

g.text: Each dot is a city. The sawtooth comes from time zones. Long slopes are countries using one clock.
